name: radio-association
description: 无线电爱好者协会信息展示系统

scripts.start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5000
scripts.dev: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000
scripts.check:python: cd backend && uv run --frozen python -m compileall -q app.py config models routes utils tests
scripts.verify: bun run check:sensitive && bun run check:source && bun run check:python && bun run test:api
scripts.verify:release: bun run verify && bun run test:e2e
